notablePrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phylath.
When Phylath dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Phylath enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder three times by sacrificing three Plants.
When the Plants die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 7, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you control at least four basic lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens, Treasure tokens and colored mana.
